description: Harness engineering and code quality skills for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: tiger-skills
plugins.description: Harness engineering + code quality skills. 10 skills, 5 agents, 1 command, and two deterministic workflows. Build pipeline: grill (deep interview -> detailed agent-facing spec.md + one-page human feature.md with the approval token, cuts feature/<id> from dev) -> lead, the ARCHITECT (plans from spec.md with recon paid once and distilled into per-task packets that inline the exact code to reuse, AUTHORS the broad priority-tagged Robot e2e suite before any code exists, returns file-disjoint waves) -> the workflow spawns one tiger-code-generator per task, concurrently in isolated git worktrees (TDD + simplify + no comments, never explores — a missing fact is a PACKET GAP) -> the architect merges every wave itself, re-verifies, audits quality, then runs the whole tiger/features/ folder for real as the single gate (Playwright for UI, triage by priority, bounded delta re-plan) -> update-docs (refresh markdown docs, fast-forward merge to dev; main protected, dev->main manual). tiger-review is the standalone on-demand quality + security gate. Second workflow — the git-free research loop (/research-goal then /research-workflow): an autonomous, self-deliberating series of genuinely-different experiments (a novelty engine forbids parameter tuning; web/arxiv-grounded; results in local research/<goalId>/experimentN/ folders). Skills are independent units; agents bundle skills.
